precision: float32 master weights; CUDA bfloat16 autocast
training_scope: official default: freeze VLM; update all 16 action expert layers, state and action interfaces; plus goal_embedding (Expert side) and goal_planner (separate group)
schedule_source: same as baseline A (LeRobot SmolVLA defaults, cosine over 30000 steps); experiment B stops at step 10000 with --stop-step to compare with A at step 10000; micro-batch 16 x 4 accumulation = effective batch 64 on the local 8 GB RTX 4060
task: Pick up the red cube and place it on the blue circle.
data_scope: experiment B (goal-conditioned Expert and planner head trained jointly): same v2 training episodes as baseline A, regenerated locally (identical episode list and stats); offline check on v2 validation episodes x 3 frames; test seeds unused

goal_conditioning.goal_vector: phase one-hot 9, delta position / 0.1 m 3, R_tcp^T R_goal 6D 6, phase aperture / 100 1, |delta| / 0.1 m 1; world frame = robot base frame
goal_conditioning.injection: zero-initialised MLP added to all 50 Expert action tokens; prefix, suffix length, masks and position ids unchanged
